SITE PLAN GENERAL NOTES:
T

1. THESE PLANS ARE FOR SITE PLAN AND PERMITTING PURPOSES ONLY FOR THE PROPOSED ACCESSORY METAL
BUILDING AT THE ADDRESS SHOWN IN THE TITLE BLOCK.
2. PROPERTY BOUNDARIES, DIMENSIONS, EASEMENTS, EXISTING STRUCTURES, AND SITE FEATURES ARE BASED ON
THE SURVEY REFERENCED ON THESE PLANS, PREPARED BY OTHERS. NO INDEPENDENT BOUNDARY OR TOPOGRAPHIC
SURVEY WAS PERFORMED AS PART OF THESE PLANS.
3. THE CONTRACTOR SHALL FIELD VERIFY ALL EXISTING CONDITIONS, DIMENSIONS, ELEVATIONS, AND THE
PROPOSED BUILDING LOCATION PRIOR TO CONSTRUCTION. ANY DISCREPANCIES SHALL BE REPORTED TO THE
DESIGN PROFESSIONAL PRIOR TO PROCEEDING.
4. THE PROPOSED STRUCTURE SHALL BE LOCATED IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE SETBACKS AND DIMENSIONS SHOWN ON
THIS SITE PLAN. THE CONTRACTOR SHALL VERIFY COMPLIANCE WITH ALL APPLICABLE ZONING REQUIREMENTS
AND PERMIT CONDITIONS PRIOR TO CONSTRUCTION.
5. NO CONSTRUCTION, FOUNDATION ELEMENTS, OR PERMANENT IMPROVEMENTS SHALL ENCROACH INTO PROPERTY
SETBACKS, EASEMENTS, RIGHTS-OF-WAY, OR RESTRICTED AREAS WITHOUT PRIOR APPROVAL FROM THE
APPLICABLE AUTHORITY.
6. STRUCTURAL DESIGN, SUPERSTRUCTURE PLANS, FOUNDATION DESIGN, ANCHORAGE, AND CONNECTION DETAILS
ARE PROVIDED UNDER SEPARATE DOCUMENTS BY OTHERS. THIS SITE PLAN DOES NOT MODIFY OR SUPERSEDE THE
APPROVED STRUCTURAL OR FOUNDATION DOCUMENTS.
7. FINISHED FLOOR ELEVATIONS, WHERE INDICATED, SHALL BE VERIFIED AGAINST APPLICABLE FLOODPLAIN
REQUIREMENTS AND FIELD CONDITIONS PRIOR TO CONSTRUCTION. ELEVATION CERTIFICATION, WHEN REQUIRED,
SHALL BE PROVIDED BY A QUALIFIED PROFESSIONAL.
8. EXISTING DRAINAGE PATTERNS SHALL BE MAINTAINED TO THE EXTENT PRACTICABLE. PROPOSED IMPROVEMENTS
SHALL NOT CREATE ADVERSE DRAINAGE IMPACTS TO ADJACENT PROPERTIES, RIGHTS-OF-WAY, OR EXISTING
DRAINAGE FACILITIES. ANY REQUIRED GRADING OR DRAINAGE DESIGN SHALL BE PROVIDED SEPARATELY.
9. THE CONTRACTOR SHALL LOCATE AND VERIFY ALL EXISTING ABOVEGROUND AND UNDERGROUND UTILITIES PRIOR
TO EXCAVATION OR CONSTRUCTION. CONTACT SUNSHINE 811 PRIOR TO DIGGING AS REQUIRED.
10. THE CONTRACTOR SHALL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR OBTAINING ALL REQUIRED PERMITS, COORDINATING
INSPECTIONS, MAINTAINING JOBSITE SAFETY, AND COMPLYING WITH APPLICABLE OSHA REQUIREMENTS.
11. ANY DAMAGE TO EXISTING STRUCTURES, UTILITIES, PAVEMENT, LANDSCAPING, OR ADJACENT IMPROVEMENTS
RESULTING FROM CONSTRUCTION SHALL BE REPAIRED BY THE CONTRACTOR.
12. ANY WETLANDS, FLOODPLAIN RESTRICTIONS, CONSERVATION AREAS, OR OTHER ENVIRONMENTALLY SENSITIVE
FEATURES AFFECTING THE PROPOSED WORK SHALL BE ADDRESSED IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF
THE APPLICABLE AUTHORITIES. NO DISTURBANCE OF PROTECTED AREAS IS AUTHORIZED BY THIS SITE PLAN.
13. THE CONTRACTOR SHALL NOTIFY THE DESIGN PROFESSIONAL OF ANY CONFLICTS, OMISSIONS, OR
DISCREPANCIES BETWEEN THE SITE PLAN, SURVEY, APPROVED BUILDING PLANS, AND ACTUAL FIELD
CONDITIONS PRIOR TO PROCEEDING WITH THE AFFECTED WORK.
14. AN APPROVED COPY OF THE SITE PLAN AND APPLICABLE PERMIT DOCUMENTS SHALL BE MAINTAINED AT THE
PROJECT SITE DURING CONSTRUCTION.
